messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Smart-routing alert — elevated error rate for tool-calling endpoints (routes returning 422/unsupported) and increased tail latency for customers corp-alpha and beta. 2xx -> 4xx spikes noted. Paging @oncall-maria and @eng-runtime-lead :rotating_light:

oncall-maria: on it, joining now. Can someone paste the earliest error sample?

jake: grabbing logs from rtr-router-03. Looks like the router is flipping between eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 repeatedly for the same session. Short loop with backoff, leads to 7-12s extra latency then 422s when it lands on quantized variant. snippet:```[2026-03-14T03:14:22Z] req=abcd123 route=policy=cost_first -> eu-central-1/model-x-q4_1 tool_call=false -> ERROR UnsupportedToolCalling: model variant lacks tool-calling handler
[2026-03-14T03:14:24Z] req=abcd123 fallback -> eu-west-1/model-x-fp16 tool_call=true -> OK but session kv mismatch -> retry -> back to eu-central-1```

tilly: so routing policy 'cost_first' is routing to quantized variant (q4_1) which we didn't mark as supporting tool-calling at eval time. It's causing UnsupportedToolCalling exceptions. Also see context_length truncation warnings in router for some requests.

eng-runtime-lead: this smells like a model-compatibility matrix bug + policy weighting issue. The router should exclude variants that don't support tool-calling when the request requests tool_call. Why did the compatibility filter not block q4_1?

jake: config shows the compatibility matrix service returned an entry for model-x variants, but the flags field for tool_call support is missing for q4_1 since ingestion job failed silently last night. compatibility-service logs:```ERROR: ingestion/variants.py:47 - variant q4_1 missing metadata: 'tool_call_support'```

oncall-maria: ok immediate mitigation ideas? We should stop the fallback loop and ensure requests that require tool_call go to a compatible variant or fail fast (so customers get immediate error rather than long latency).

eng-runtime-lead: mitigation 1 (hotfix): update routing policy to prefer region affinity for the affected customers and mark 'reject-incompatible' for tool_call requests. I'll push a temporary policy change to policy-store to add an explicit rule for corp-alpha and corp-beta.

support-liz: I've opened ticket #INC-4472 and messaging corp-alpha PM; they reported intermittent tool errors in their chat integrations. Liz -> corp-alpha: "we're rolling a targeted fix, short-term you'll see reduced latency, we'll follow up with root cause."

jake: applying policy patch now:```PATCH /policystore/rules/replace```
payload:
```
- match: customer: any
  prefer: cost_first
+ match: customer: [corp-alpha, corp-beta]
  prefer: region_affinity
  constraints:
    - require_variant_flag: tool_call_support == true
  fallback: fail_fast
```
applied on rtr-router-02/03/04 at 03:22Z

dmitri: rolled the policy. Observability shows immediate drop in 4xxs from 9% -> 0.4% for those customers within ~60s. Latency normalized. Good job. :thumbsup:

tilly: we still have the root ingestion failure to fix — compatibility service accepted the variant but didn't ingest its metadata. Need postmortem item: harden ingestion pipeline and add k8s liveness + alert when expected flags are missing.

eng-runtime-lead: agreed. Also, long-term we need a routing validation step that rejects routing policies which can create region fallback loops (i.e., two policies preferring distinct regions with fallbacks configured to each other). For now I've added a temporary guard in router: max_region_hops=2.

oncall-maria: handoff: I'm on-call until 11:00Z, will monitor for 30m then hand to @tilly for next shift. Leave notes: policy rollback id p-2026-03-14-01 was applied; corp-alpha/beta pinned to region_affinity with reject-incompatible.

support-liz: Customers notified: corp-alpha ticket INC-4472 (acknowledged, mitigation in progress), corp-beta contacted via CSM; both escalated to SEs. Adding status page update?

eng-runtime-lead: yes, small status page patch: "Partial service degradation for advanced tool-calling features for select customers; mitigation deployed." Posted at 03:35Z.

jake: post-mortem actions I created: PM-1: fix ingestion job to ensure variant metadata validated and retried on failure; PM-2: add compatibility flags to model-catalog API and surface in Console; PM-3: add router preflight check for tool_call=true to filter incompatible variants; PM-4: add unit tests for policy-store to detect mutual fallback cycles.

dmitri: one more bug found in logs: quantized variant q4_1 had truncated KV cache size causing context_length warnings. That explains some hallucinations customers reported. Need to re-run quantized validation suite with full context emulation.

tilly: assigning owners: ingestion fix -> jake; console/catalog flags -> eng-runtime-lead; router preflight -> tilly; mutual fallback detection -> policy team (dmitri). ETA 2 weeks for all items, except ingestion hotfix (48h).

oncall-maria: leaving final note before handoff: keep max_region_hops guard until mutual fallback detection is in prod. If you see any reappearance, escalate to ops and call me.

support-liz: corp-alpha confirms errors cleared, corp-beta seeing reduced errors. Both appreciate rapid response.

eng-runtime-lead: after-action: we should add a compatibility matrix unit to our model onboarding checklist: fields [quantized=true/false, fp16=true/false, max_context=, tool_call_support=true/false, streaming_support=true/false]. Also add a gating check that blocks routing policy changes that would route tool_call=true requests to variants with tool_call_support=false.

jake: logs + snippets have been saved to s3://redwood-incident-archive/1747104829/ for later analysis.

oncall-maria: handing off to @tilly (oncall) at 04:05Z. I'll remain reachable.

tilly: taking over monitoring. If issues recur, we'll switch to full traffic pin to fp16 variants for affected models.

customer-ops: Thanks all — raising internal brief for CSMs to coordinate finer customer communications in the morning.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: routing hotfix applied and stabilization confirmed. Postmortem draft requested from eng-runtime (owner: eng-runtime-lead).

eng-runtime-lead: drafting postmortem now, will include timeline, root cause (compat ingestion failure + permissive policy weighting), mitigation steps, and action items with owners/ETAs. Will post to #postmortems and link back here.

tilly: noted, closing monitoring window at 04:25Z. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
